name: language-teacher-workspace
description: Convenience scripts that forward to server/ and frontend/. Each folder has its own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix frontend test
